versions.content: The Communication Management shall provide an API to sup- port reading and writing raw data streams that has no datatype information Description: The Communication Management shall provide an API to support reading and writing raw data streams that has no datatype information. Rationale: A separate API is needed, since using SOME/IP services for raw data streams requires typed data and serialization, which introduces unnecessary overhead. Dependencies: – Use Case: Exchanging binary data between an ECU running adaptive applications and sensors in a car. Supporting Material: –
